title: Storage PRO Archive Roots and Operator UX Hardening
summary: Hardens the Storage PRO archive-root workflow with operator-safe root add/activate/delete flows, visible archive-root problem details, runtime activation handoff, and compact user-facing storage UX corrections.
changelog: Reworks archive-root add flow to use NAS volume discovery and folder creation instead of raw manual paths.
Adds explicit inactive archive-root activation through the setup-helper runtime handoff with operator warning.
Adds safe inactive archive-root deletion with confirmation, permission checks, metadata cleanup and recording-list consistency.
Shows archive-root problems as compact clickable user-facing details instead of long table text.
Polishes Storage PRO root/status controls, short problem badges, dialog copy and focused visual contract tests.
